data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 温泉水汽的青梅回眸
data.description: 露天私人温泉的水面上漂浮着木质水瓢与毛巾，腾起的热雾将山石与竹篱装点得如梦如幻。伊莉娜半蹲在池水边缘，水流没过泛红的大腿。湿润的栗色双马尾贴在雪白光滑的脊背上，她急忙用浸湿的白色小毛巾遮在胸前，回过头来向你吐了吐舌头，娇羞中透着无拘无束的青梅竹马灵动。
data.location: steamy outdoor secluded natural hot spring
data.action: crouching in steaming hot spring water, wet chestnut twintails, holding small wet towel over chest, water droplets on bare shoulders, blushing flustered playful expression looking back
data.lighting: warm lantern light glowing through dense rising steam mist
data.mood: cheerful nostalgic romance, flustered innocent charm
data.promptProse: Crouching in a warm outdoor hot spring veiled in steam, Irina looks back over her bare shoulder with a flustered blush. Her wet chestnut twintails glisten as she holds a small towel with cute embarrassment.
data.animaCaption: Irina crouching in a steamy outdoor hot spring with wet twintails, blushing cutely.
